## Description {#details}

<p>This file defines CachedHashString and CachedHashStringRef.</p>


<p>These are owning and not-owning string types that store their hash in addition to their string data.</p>


<p>Unlike std::string, CachedHashString can be used in DenseSet/DenseMap (because, unlike std::string, CachedHashString lets us have empty and tombstone values).</p>
